source.quote: SMSL's own page for the SU-X, read 2026-11-24: « ES9039MS PRO ×2 Support MQA decoding and MQA-CD »; « ES9039MSPRO from American ESS, built-in MQA decoding »; « The brand-new third-generation XMOS XU-316, PCM supports to 32bit/768kHz, and DSD supports to DSD512 »; « USB, optical, coaxial, AES and I2S support DSD, while coaxial, optical and AES support DOP64 »; « Qualcomm's high-end Bluetooth chip, supports LDAC(24bit/96kHz),APTX/HD, SBC, AAC ».

facts.chip: TWO ES9039MSPRO (ESS) - « ES9039MS PRO ×2 » - with a third-generation XMOS XU-316 as the USB interface and a Qualcomm part for Bluetooth.

_five_inputs_again: Same five-input split as smsl/su-10, and the same maker's wording: all five carry DSD, the three S/PDIF-family ones carry it as DoP64, so USB and I2S are the native pair.
